subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap & next steps

Hi Tom —

Great to meet you and Samantha today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned on scope, success criteria, and timing. Please reply with any corrections.

Pain points you shared:
- High inference cost at scale with current vendor; want predictable unit economics.
- Inconsistent latency on peak workloads causing UX issues for customers.
- Need stronger observability and cost breakdowns per route/model.

Goals / success criteria:
- Bring token cost down ~30% while keeping p99 latency <= 250ms for core flows.
- Run a 4-week technical pilot on a subset of traffic (Map feature) and validate KPIs.
- Have SSO + SOC2 evidence in place for procurement sign-off.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft attached):
1) Week of Apr 4 — Technical deep-dive & environment access (owners: Vivek, Tom)
2) Week of Apr 11 — Pilot deployment and baseline metrics collected (owners: Acme engineering + Redwood infra)
3) Week of Apr 25 — Performance tuning, batching/cache config, and cost projections (owners: Redwood)
4) May 9 — Pilot review & decision (stakeholders: Tom (Product), Samantha (Security), Jessica (Procurement))

Decision process: Product approves technical fit -> Security checks SOC2 & SSO -> Procurement issues PO. Target decision date: May 9.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Share the draft MAP (attached) and a short SOC2 summary.
- Schedule two meetings: (1) technical deep-dive with Vivek; (2) pilot kickoff.

Could you confirm the stakeholders above (Product/Security/Procurement) and that the target decision window works for you? Also, please add Jessica from procurement if she should be included.

Attachments: acme-map-draft.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Tom — I’m Vivek, I’ll run the technical deep-dive and pilot setup. Thanks for outlining the concerns — we can address each in the session. Quick notes from my side:

1) Isolation: We can offer a dedicated pool for the pilot (dedicated GPUs) to avoid multi-tenant interference. I’ll include expected cost delta in the follow-up.
2) SSO: We support SAML-based SSO and can share the integration checklist (IdP metadata, attribute mappings). Plan is to have SSO test-ready during pilot.
3) Data access: For the pilot we’ll need a sample of the Map payloads and an estimate of peak tokens per-minute to size the pool.

Proposed times for deep-dive (all PDT): Apr 6 9:00-10:00, Apr 7 9:00-10:00. I’ll block Apr 6 9:00 for now, please confirm.

I’m attaching a short runbook snippet for pilot telemetry and an example config we typically use.

—
